high: factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:241 — Touch-overlap assertion tests an empty page — the ownership check runs after line 237 returns to the world map, where no .lmp-slot, .lmp-school, or .lmp-cand elements exist; boxes is empty and both claimed geometry assertions pass vacuously — run the geometry checks while the PLAY board is mounted, including ready-school and filled-tray states, and assert the expected control count before testing rectangles.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:102 — Digit prohibition ignores accessible names — seen.boardText contains only visible text, so a numeric score placed in an aria-label inside .lmp is not checked; the later aria allow-list also strips everything after ：, allowing labels such as an allowed prefix followed by ：100 — accumulate board-scoped text and aria-labels separately and reject digits in both without normalization.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:101 — Transient pre-CLEAR job-name leaks are not detected — the job-name check occurs only at screenshots; the MutationObserver accumulates strings without recording whether CLEAR had happened, and 栄養教諭 is already allow-listed from copy.ts, so a short pre-CLEAR flash passes — record each mutation with the current flow phase and fail immediately when a forbidden job name appears before reveal.
medium: src/v2/lunch/play/lunchMenuLogic.ts:243 — swap() can mutate a cleared or malformed session — unlike place() and remove(), swap() never rejects phase === "cleared" and never verifies inId is a candidate; the harness's “cleared session is inert” assertion omits swap entirely — reject cleared sessions and non-candidate IDs in swap(), then include swap in the cleared-session invariant.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:105 — Aria allow-list is not verbatim — removing parenthesized and colon-delimited suffixes contradicts the claimed every-string-verbatim contract and permits invented verdicts or scores after an approved prefix — compare complete generated labels against an explicit set of expected dynamic labels instead of truncating them.

src/v2/lunch/screens/screens.css:8 — Post-CLEAR screens omit the top safe-area inset — padding has a fixed 26px top while only the bottom uses env(safe-area-inset-bottom), so headings and controls can enter a notched or Dynamic Island region — use max(26px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) for top padding.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:241 — Mobile target-size coverage is absent — the harness claims control geometry safety but checks neither the 44×44 minimum nor disabled/ready-school states, and its current placement makes even overlap checks vacuous — assert dimensions and ownership for every interactive control at each relevant PLAY state.
low: factory/harness/gameplay-qa-v2-lunch-menu.mjs:129 — “Almost every” near-miss check deliberately permits defects — up to two near-miss trays may require two swaps while the surrounding comments and model documentation claim every one-axis-off menu is one swap away — either enforce zero exceptions or revise the documented claim and print the exceptional trays.

factory/harness/gameplay-qa-v2-lunch-menu.mjs:23 — QA reports success despite Vite initialization errors — execution emitted WebSocket EPERM and cache mkdir EPERM errors yet exited 0 with 54/54, making environmental failures easy to overlook — disable HMR/optimization for the SSR loader or treat initialization errors as harness failures.

recommended_actions: Move touch ownership/overlap checks into mounted PLAY states, assert a nonzero expected control count, and add 44×44 target-size assertions.
Replace aria-label normalization with exact expected-label generation; apply digit checks to all board-scoped text and accessible names.
Make the MutationObserver phase-aware so transient job-name leaks and other forbidden pre-CLEAR content fail regardless of screenshot timing.
Harden swap() and extend the inert-cleared-session test to cover it and malformed IDs.
Run the seven named mutations in a writable scratch worktree and preserve a per-mutation pass/fail report; include aria-only score and transient job-name mutations in that suite.
Fix top safe-area padding and rerun the 375×812 browser flow on a notched-device emulation.
